scope: Four S133/S134 Spring Casual products checked at full 1350x1800 source resolution
boardTitle: Four Spring Casual products · full-source correction audit
boardNote: Three catalog products rejected for oversized or puddled proportions · one cropped brown jacket retained · no outfit approval or UI integration

entries.label: Flower-Apricot Knit Henley
entries.reason: The full source shows a dropped shoulder, wide elbow-length sleeve and long straight body extending well below the hip. The soft color is useful, but the silhouette repeats the oversized-top problem and fails catalog acceptance.

entries.label: Lavender Oversized Crew T-Shirt
entries.reason: The full worn view contradicts the regular-crew label: the shoulder is dropped, sleeves are broad and the hem is long over the upper thigh. It is a generic oversized tee, not the controlled Zara-led top required.

entries.label: Light-Blue Puddled Jean
entries.reason: The jean is broad through thigh and lower leg and visibly folds onto both shoes. It is neither a controlled straight cut nor a clean break, so it repeats the baggy-bottom failure and leaves the accepted pool.

entries.label: Brown Faux-Suede Cropped Zip Jacket
entries.reason: The warm-brown jacket has a modern cropped hip length, simple zip, controlled shoulder and useful suede texture. Keep as S134's only hold; pair with a regular-length colored top and controlled ecru or gray bottom, never another loose piece.
